edgeDirected.label: Edge-directed
edgeDirected.hint: Detects the direction of edges and interpolates along them: star profiles and nebula outlines stay smooth, with no stair-stepping or halos. It does not add detail that is not there.
edgeDirected.over2x: You are upscaling more than 2×. The Edge-directed method avoids stair-stepping and halos, but the extra detail does not exist in the source data.

lanczos.label: Lanczos
lanczos.hint: Classic filter, sharp and faithful, but on diagonal edges it can leave small steps and dark halos around bright stars.
lanczos.over2x: You are upscaling more than 2×. The Lanczos filter keeps star profiles sharp, but the extra detail does not exist in the source data.

waitForJob: Wait for the current operation to finish, then export.

noImage.title: Export
noImage.text: Open an image to export it.

format.title: Format
format.description: PNG, TIFF and BMP save without quality loss, and TIFF at sixteen bits per channel. JPEG and WebP produce lightweight files for sharing. FITS keeps sixteen bits and the capture data.

quality.label: Quality
quality.hint: Above ninety percent the loss is hard to notice.

keepMetadata.label: Keep capture data
keepMetadata.hint: Copies the header of the source file, with the capture data, into the new file.

markers.label: Include object markers
markers.hint: Draws the circles and names of the recognized objects on the image, as in the viewer.

coordinates.label: Include coordinates
coordinates.hint: Draws the coordinate grid, orientation and scale bar turned on in the Objects step on the image, as in the viewer.

framing.title: Framing

full.title: Go back to using the whole image
full.label: Full

framing.description: Drag the box to choose the area to export. The dark part is left out. With the Crop button at the top, you can also edit it in the viewer.

size.label: Box size
size.hint: Shrinking the box enlarges the subject but uses fewer pixels from the original.

selection.name: Selected area
selection.hint: Pixels actually available in the cropped area

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Sizes recommended by the platforms, at which the image is shown without automatic cropping.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.presetNote: The size is set by the selected preset. Press Custom to choose it yourself.

upscaling.name: Upscaling
upscaling.hint: Relative to the pixels actually available in the selected area

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: A small caption with the capture data and the StarLight logo, inside the photo. If you don’t want to cover even a corner of the image, turn it off with one click.

add.label: Add caption
add.hint: This choice is saved and also applies to batch processing.

caption.notAllowed: StarLight does not add a caption in {format} format: it is a data file and the image stays untouched for measurements. The capture data stays in the file header.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.hint: A small, semi-transparent line in a corner of the photo
minimal.description: A small, semi-transparent line in the corner you choose, with the StarLight logo. This is the most discreet template.

banner.label: Banner
banner.hint: A thin dark strip at the bottom, over the photo, with the data on one line
banner.description: A semi-transparent dark strip at the bottom, full width, with the data on one line and the StarLight logo on the right.

card.label: Card
card.hint: A dark box in a corner, with the object name and the data on two lines
card.description: A semi-transparent dark box in the corner you choose, with the object name as the title and the data on two lines. Designed for social media.

author.label: Author (optional)
author.placeholder: Your name, if you want to sign the photo

location.label: Show location
location.hint: Only the place name, if the file includes it. StarLight never writes geographic coordinates.

data.none: The file contains no capture data, so only the StarLight logo will appear.
data.found: Data found: {entries}. Missing data is not shown.
data.foundSomeOmitted: Data found: {entries}. Missing data is not shown. At this size some entries are left out for lack of space.

changed.title: Values changed since the last Apply. The viewer already shows them.
changed.label: changed

apply.title: Frame the exported area in the viewer, with the caption as it will appear in the file
apply.label: Apply
